title: Weyl gauge symmetry at LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA
summary: With current advances in gravitational wave (GW) detection made by the worldwide LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) network of detectors, ever-more sensitive tests of gravity in the strong-field regime are now possible. This enables one to test gauge theories beyond Einstein-Hilbert action, such as Weyl gauge theories of gravity. The only anomaly-free (quantum) gauge theory of a space-time symmetry beyond Poincaré is based on Weyl gauge group (of dilatations and Poincaré symmetry) with Weyl conformal geometry as its natural underlying geometry.
